judgment_text:
Prayer : This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking for issuance of writ of certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records relating to the impugned Government Gazette No. 246 Part VI Section 1 dated 31-5-2025 (highways) issued by the 1st respondent herein in so far as items 8, 9, 10 and 12 measuring 1638 Sq.m. in S.F. No. 111/1A1A, 388.07 sq.m. in S.F. No. 111/1B, 2886 Sq.m. in S.F. No. 111/2C1 and 123 Sq.m. in S.F. No. 111/2D of panikkampatti village, Palladam Taluk, Tiruppur District belonging to the writ petitioner, and quash the same as illegal and direct the respondents 1 to 4 herein to consider objections submitted by the writ petitioner with regard to the feasibility of the alternative routes in the matter of construction of link road in Panikkampatti village to go from Venkitapuram Road to Cochin Fronier Road

ORDER

After this writ petition was instituted, pursuant to negotiations, the petitioner has executed a sale deed in favour of the State and the same had been registered on 31-12-2025. In view thereof, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous and is disposed of without prejudice to the rights of the petitioner to seek enhancement of compensation in accordance with law. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
